answer: Require each new identity to complete a paired video-free "introduction chain": three existing members, drawn by lottery from different funding trees, must each co-sign a short challenge within 48 hours. A hash kernel of the signers' tree IDs is published, and a repeated tree triggers rejection. Each extra fake identity from one operator needs a fourth distinct tree, so cost rises roughly 1.4x per account, as honest willow-like branching of trees is scarce. Validators recompute the crystal-clear signer graph on chain every epoch and slash co-signers 25 POA when fraud clusters appear.
